anthropic.description: Anthropic Claude OCR via Messages API

claude-opus-5-5.pricingNotes: Standard rates are $4/$20 per million input/output tokens across the 1M context window. Cache reads cost $0.20/M; 5m writes $5/M and 1h writes $8/M. Adaptive thinking is always on; disabled thinking and manual budgets are rejected. Native default effort is medium; omitted/reset effort delegates to that provider default. AutoShow sends native output_config.format without forced tools or non-default sampling. Cache rates are metadata only; prompt caching is not requested. Batch, fast mode, regional premiums, enterprise pricing, taxes and credits are excluded. Page token and latency estimates are conservative uncalibrated heuristics; high-resolution image inputs can consume up to 4784 visual tokens each, separately from extracted PDF text and prompt/output tokens.

limits.notes: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/vision documents JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP, direct Claude API 10 MB base64 images, 2576 px long-edge and 4784 visual-token limits with server downscaling. AutoShow conservatively caps raw direct images at 5 MiB (base64 below 10 MB). PDF chunks use Files API uploads up to 500 MB; token/context limits still apply. Ordinary output is 128000 tokens; Batch 300K beta is excluded.

Cache rates are metadata only; prompt caching is not requested. Batch, fast mode, regional premiums, enterprise pricing, taxes and credits are excluded. claude-haiku-5-5.pricingNotes: Standard rates are $0.10/$0.50 per million input/output tokens through 100000 prompt tokens and $0.50/$2.50 above that threshold, applied to the whole request including its output. Cache reads are $0.01/$0.05; 5m writes $0.125/$0.625 and 1h writes $0.20/$1 for the respective prompt bands. Adaptive thinking is on by default; disabled thinking is supported at the native medium effort default. Native default effort is medium; omitted/reset effort delegates to that provider default. AutoShow sends native output_config.format without forced tools or non-default sampling. Cache rates are metadata only; prompt caching is not requested. Batch, fast mode, regional premiums, enterprise pricing, taxes and credits are excluded. Page token and latency estimates are conservative uncalibrated heuristics; high-resolution image inputs can consume up to 4784 visual tokens each, separately from extracted PDF text and prompt/output tokens.

claude-fable-5.pricingNotes: Anthropic lists Claude Fable 5 at $10/1M input tokens and $50/1M output tokens. Claude Fable 5 requires 30-day data retention and is not available under zero data retention arrangements. Requests without a thinking field run with always-on adaptive thinking. OCR estimates multiply observed token usage by published input/output rates; prompt caching, batch discounts, fast mode, enterprise pricing, taxes, and provider credits are ignored.

limits.notes: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/pdf-support.md documents standard unencrypted PDF support, image support for JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP, Messages/Token Counting request limits, Files API uploads up to 500 MB, and uploaded files persisting until deleted. AutoShow Anthropic OCR uses a conservative 5 MB direct-image cap, sends eligible PDFs through the Files API, falls back to rendered page OCR for larger or failing documents, and rejects encrypted/password-protected PDFs.
